display.title: T2: The Pulverizer
display.subtitle: Thermal ore doubling
description: The §bPulverizer§r is Thermal's grinder - it doubles ore into dust and is
the front half of the §b3x ore§r chain when it feeds the Induction Smelter.
Build a Pulverizer to complete this beat. Run its dust through the Smelter
with sand for the full triple yield.
